summary: Tested Biblioteca Escolar RGB MVP end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass for GET /api/, GET /api/links (empty + nested format), POST /api/links (valid url, invalid url -> 400, upsert), GET /api/links/{grado_id}, DELETE /api/links/{grado_id}/{materia_id}. Frontend: Homepage loads with Header (RGB logo), Hero, Search, Categories (Primaria/Secundaria/Media), Featured Books, CTA, Footer. Hierarchical modal flow works: hero CTA opens modal -> Nivel view -> click primaria -> Grado view -> click g1 -> Materias view (8 inputs). Saving https URL shows success toast, Go button becomes enabled, link persists in MongoDB after page reload. Back btn navigates up, ESC closes modal, overlay click closes modal, Remove button deletes link with toast.
critical_code_review_comments: main.py line 116: @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in modern FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan context manager.
POST /api/links accepts URLs starting with '/' (relative paths) which deviates from spec saying only http/https; harmless but worth noting.
DELETE returns {deleted: 0} with status 200 when resource does not exist; consider 404 for stricter REST semantics (current behavior is fine for an idempotent UI delete).
Frontend Header testid is 'app-header' and Footer is 'app-footer' (not site-header/site-footer) - just naming, no bug.
LibraryContext saveLink/removeLink lack try/catch around axios calls at context level - errors propagate to component which handles toast (acceptable).
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up via fixtures in test_library_api.py (TEST_ prefix on materia ids: test_matematicas, test_lengua under grado g1). UI test data also cleaned via Remove button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_library_api.py covers all 6 link CRUD scenarios. For frontend, use data-testid: hero-cta-primary (open modal), modal-nivel-{id}, modal-grado-{id}, materia-input-{id}, materia-save-{id}, materia-go-{id}, materia-remove-{id}, modal-back-btn, modal-close-btn, library-modal-overlay. First materia in g1 has id 'mat'. Persistence via MongoDB confirmed after reload.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All flows working as designed.
